attributes.institutional_conclusion: AFRP now has research-depth public real-yield, breakeven, CFTC positioning, official inflation, policy-rate, FX, and oil histories with governed provenance. These datasets improve confounder control and reactivate previously blocked observational research, but no result is causally identified. ETF redistribution rights, consensus surprises, futures-implied expectations, intraday sequencing, and valid causal designs remain unresolved.
